question with acheter in the text. Some candidates were unable to identify when Marco worked in the shop
for 3(d) or his mode of transport for 3(f), maybe not knowing that vélo and bicyclette are synonyms.

trip to England. Some candidates thought Louise was a boy and answered questions with il or Louis
throughout the exercise. Candidates are not expected to recognise names so this was not an issue unless it
was unclear who was being referred to in the answers.
